title: Stars Guard the Heavens; the Day of Judgement Comes

paragraphs.text: Allah has made the nearest heaven beautiful with stars. They also protect it from every rebellious devil, so that the devils cannot listen to the high assembly of angels. The devils are driven away and hit from every side, and they will have a punishment that never ends. If one of them manages to steal a few words by theft, a bright burning flame, sharp and piercing, quickly chases him away.

The Prophet is told to ask the disbelievers whether they are harder to create than the other things Allah has made. Allah created humans from sticky clay. The Prophet is amazed, while they only make fun. When they are reminded, they do not take the lesson. When they see a sign, they laugh at it and call it clear magic. They ask in surprise whether they will really be raised again after they die and become dust and bones, and whether their forefathers will also be raised. The Prophet must answer, "Yes, and you will be humbled." On that Day, there will be only one single shout, and at once they will all be standing up and looking around.

Then they will cry, "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense." They will be told, "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny." After that, the angels will be ordered to gather those who did wrong, together with others like them, and the things they used to worship.

hardWords.m: a group of beings gathered together
holding on to things, like glue
